visual_targets: single centered full-body anime character from head to boots
short black hair carrying exactly one narrow cobalt front streak on the character-left side
one compact messenger bag on the character-right hip with its strap over the character-left shoulder
matte charcoal courier jacket with sparse cobalt piping over fitted black cargo trousers and plain black boots
clean precise line art with restrained two-step cel shading
muted charcoal, black and gray palette with limited cobalt accent
plain light-gray studio background and neutral lighting without scenery or text

human_criteria.label: The same adult anime face reads clearly in every view
Exactly one cobalt front streak survives every view, stays on character-left, and is never mirrored
The single messenger bag keeps its size, colour and shoulder-to-hip strap path in every view
Jacket layers, piping, trousers, boots and body proportions stay consistent
Line art, two-step cel shading and the plain studio background stay clean in every view

prohibited_transfer: using the benchmark reference as an identity or image-edit source for a different character
copying Kaito's face, hair or outfit into another character
treating output from a rejected method as an accepted target
scoring a view by prompt adherence alone while ignoring the locked reference
